overall_summary: Analysis of historical data reveals that relationship and marriage-centric emotional content (specifically husband-wife dynamics) significantly outperforms general sad shayari or broad family tropes, driving nearly 10x more views (e.g., ~1700 views compared to the 20-300 range for other formats).

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,768 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,676 views) heavily outperformed all other topics.
winning_patterns.action: Focus core production heavily on marital and long-term relationship nuances rather than standalone poetic sad shayari.

weak_patterns.pattern: Generic Sad/Poetic Shayari with Heavy Metaphors
weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 20 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly dramatic, poetic, or abstract lines in titles and hooks; anchor content in concrete everyday scenarios.
